issues.description: Inconsistent naming of the first-name property in the shared Person model: the problem statement UML and template code define the attribute as `firstName` (implying `getFirstName()`/`setFirstName()`), but the solution's `Person` class declares it as `givenName` with `getGivenName()`/`setGivenName()`. This breaks the contract used by the client UI (`PersonScene` binds table columns to the `firstName` property) and by server-side logic/sorting options that refer to `FIRST_NAME`, leading to compilation errors or runtime binding failures depending on which artifact is used.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution `Person` model with the exercise contract by renaming `givenName` to `firstName` and providing `getFirstName()`/`setFirstName()`. Alternatively (not recommended), update the problem statement, template model, and all UI bindings/controllers/services to consistently use `givenName`.
